title: Cozy Campfires
description: Adds immersive health regeneration near regular campfires and a protective blindness near soul campfires when crouching.
body:
# 🔥 Cozy Campfires

A cozy, immersive Quality of Life mod that transforms campfires from simple decorations into meaningful places of recovery and meditation! It utilizes vanilla mechanics like hay bales and bone blocks to upgrade your campfire resting experience.

### ✨ Features

#### 🪵 Regular Campfire
Crouching near a lit campfire within a 4-block radius grants you healing powers:
* **Default:** Grants **Regeneration I**.
* **Upgraded:** Place a **Hay Bale** under the campfire to intensify the smoke and upgrade the effect to **Regeneration II**.

#### 💎 Soul Campfire
Crouching near a soul campfire plunges you into a defensive state, granting **Blindness** while protecting your body with **Resistance**:
* **Default:** Grants **Resistance I** along with the **Blindness**.
* **Upgraded:** Place a **Bone Block** under the soul campfire to channel soul energy and upgrade the effect to **Resistance II**.

**Developed for Minecraft 1.21.1 via NeoForge.**

_See Gallery for examples._
